description_en: Queries the usage data of online editing in ApsaraVideo VOD
description_zh: 调用DescribeVodEditingUsageData查询点播云剪辑用量
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-editing-usage-data --start-time 2024-11-06T16:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-07T16:00:00Z --biz-region cn-beijing --specification H264.SD --app-id app-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodEditingUsageData

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you leave this parameter empty, data from the last 24 hours is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。

若为空，则默认读取最近24小时的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The region. By default, data from all regions is returned. You can specify multiple regions separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 地域。默认返回所有地域。支持批量查询，多个区域用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

Duration.description_en: The audio or video duration. Unit: seconds

TimeStamp.description_en: The start time of the time interval. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
TimeStamp.description_zh: 时间片起始时刻。使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
EndTime.description_zh: 获取数据结束时间点。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
StartTime.description_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
